name: ContextFab
what: Agent operating system for manufacturing: a live graph of factory data that people and AI agents can query and act on.
homonym_note: Not contextflow (Vienna medical imaging), which appears in the same Deutsche Startups headline.

membership.basis: Register: Visionaries Club Seed Fund II is named on ContextFab GmbH's shareholder list of 2025-10-09; Deutsche Startups (2026-06-02) reports Visionaries Club investing.

notes: ContextFab GmbH, Munich HRB 305930, registered 2025-09-26 as SemSight Ventures GmbH, founders Marc Krüger-Sprengel and Louis Saade (Deutsche Startups: founded 2025 in Munich). Deutsche Startups gives no amount or round; 'Pre-Seed-Investor' describes Yellow, not the round. The round is plainly the company's first (pre-seed/seed); judge to name it. Tech.eu's weekly recap (2026-06-08) repeats the Deutsche Startups item. Not on the visionaries.vc live list (recall candidate from the register).
